Class BinaryValues

java.lang.Object
dev.hardwood.reader.BinaryValues
@Experimental public final class BinaryValues extends Object

The values of a BYTE_ARRAY, FIXED_LEN_BYTE_ARRAY or INT96 leaf in a ColumnReader's batch, from ColumnReader.getBinaryValues(). Value i is the i-th leaf value, i in [0, size()). A null value has length 0 (see ColumnReader.getLeafValidity()), and getBinary(int) returns an empty array for it.

Value i occupies [start(i), end(i)) of buffer(i). A loop over a value's bytes reads that range of the array:

BinaryValues values = column.getBinaryValues();
for (int i = 0; i < values.size(); i++) {
    byte[] buffer = values.buffer(i);
    for (int p = values.start(i); p < values.end(i); p++) {
        consume(buffer[p]);
    }
}

buffer(i) is an array value i can be read from, valid as long as the batch is. Do not write to it. Values may or may not share an array, and nothing is promised about which array a value is read from or about bytes outside its range.

This API is Experimental: it may change in future releases without prior deprecation.
